## Joe's Journey.

**“Transforming my mistakes into your valuable lessons.”**

My hair loss journey started at the young age of just 19. When I started to lose my hair, I also lost my identity and my confidence. Hair loss robbed me of a carefree existence throughout the youngest years of my life.

Out of desperation to save my existing hair, I underwent every hair loss procedure within the industry. I’m willing to admit that I’ve spent £50k in an attempt to save my hair. I’ve undergone laser treatment, tried the hairpiece system, and endured three failed hair transplants, along with years of toxic medications. Unfortunately, none of these efforts have been successful.

I reached a point in my life where I was ready to accept my male pattern baldness. However, shortly after, I discovered Scalp Micropigmentation (SMP)—a hair loss procedure that offered the perfect solution. With SMP, I could maintain a shaved look while enjoying a full hairline with instant results and long-term durability. It’s a treatment that addresses all the concerns of those experiencing hair loss. I can honestly say that SMP has transformed my life. Following the treatment, my lost confidence returned, and I felt like a whole new person.

I’ve built a career around a treatment that not only saved me but also gave me the opportunity to assist others struggling with the emotional toll of hair loss. Scalp Micropigmentation is undoubtedly the most powerful and rewarding skill in my skill set. Each client has their own unique hair loss story, and I have the privilege of guiding them through the transformative journey of SMP, alleviating their hair loss concerns along the way.

title: SMP - Scalp Micropigmentation Services
markdown:
## What is SMP?

Scalp micropigmentation also known as SMP is a non surgical, cosmetic hair loss tattoo treatment. SMP is a medical art form of tattoo that uses a precise pointillism technique in which small distinct ink dots are embedded into the upper layer of the dermis, found just below the epidermal layer of the skin on the scalp, creating an illusion of a replicated natural shaved hair follicle.

This specialised technique is a layering process and provides the technician the ability to create the desired density to suit their clients individual skin tones and hair colour.

Scalp micropigmentation is a treatment that can offer life changing results to an array of hair loss conditions.

[Start your hair confidence journey today](https://www.hairlusion.com/get-in-touch/)

## Who is suitable for smp?

Scalp Micropigmentation is a non-surgical treatment that offers long-lasting results, suitable for an extensive range of hair loss cases.

- HAIR LOSS
- Receding Hairlines
- Thinning Hairlines
- Thinning Hair Transplants
- Hair Transplant Scars

- Surgical Scars
- Head Injury Scars
- Follicle Scalp Damage
- Alopecia
- Chemotherapy Effects

## MY Bespoke Technique

People often inquire about the uniqueness of my work compared to other technicians. The secret lies in the years I’ve spent perfecting my own bespoke technique. Unlike standard methods, my approach guarantees results that not only look natural but also seamlessly blend in, remaining virtually undetectable. This dedication to refinement and precision makes Hairlusion the ultimate destination for those seeking authentic and discreet hair restoration solutions.

[Book your consultation](https://www.hairlusion.com/get-in-touch/)

## You don't have to shave your head

I believe I’ve advanced the industry by adapting Scalp Micropigmentation (SMP) to enhance hair density for individuals with thinning hair, without the need to shave your head. This method enables clients to maintain longer hairstyles and complements hair transplant procedures, offering superior density that transplants alone may not achieve.

[See the results](https://www.hairlusion.com/portfolio/)

At Hairlusion, your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities. That’s why we provide thorough before and after treatment advice. We want you to be well-informed before booking your treatment, understanding any guidelines that may impact your schedule and recovery.
Your well-being is paramount, and we’re here to support you every step of the way.

title: SMP Aftercare
markdown:
## SMP before and After Treatment care.

At Hairlusion, your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities. That’s why we provide thorough before and after treatment advice. We want you to be well-informed before booking your treatment, understanding any guidelines that may impact your schedule and recovery.
Your well-being is paramount, and we’re here to support you every step of the way.

[View treatments](https://www.hairlusion.com/pricing/)

## Pre Treatment Guidelines.

- Avoid blood thinners and fish oil supplements 7 days before your treatment.
- Avoid alcohol, and caffeine 24 hours before treatment.
- Ensure a full night’s sleep and meal before your appointment.
- Wash your hair and scalp with regular shampoo (condition if you have dry scalp) before the treatment, on the treatment day.
- Schedule your treatment away from any significant events, including strenuous activities that could lead to sweating or irritation, and avoid swimming or getting your scalp wet to ensure optimal healing.
- For women, plan your treatments around menstrual cycles for reduced pain tolerance.

[View treatments](https://www.hairlusion.com/pricing/)

## Post Treatment Guidelines.

**Days 1-5**

- Avoid touching, showering, shampooing, conditioning, excessive sweating, direct sunlight, swimming, and shaving immediately after your treatment.
- Wash gently with lukewarm water and shampoo on Day 5.
- Pat dry and apply non-perfumed moisturiser 3 times daily.
- Light exercise permitted.

**Day 7**

- Resume normal routine, including showering and exercise.

**Day 30**

- Sunbathing, swimming, sauna, sunbeds permitted.
- To protect your SMP apply oil free SPF sunscreen in sunlight.
- Apply non-perfumed moisturiser daily.
- Consult GP for pre-existing medical conditions.
- SMP is not suitable for pregnant or breastfeeding individuals, or for anyone with an active scalp condition such as folliculitis.
- Consult a GP if you experience excessive swelling, pain, or heat radiating from the treated area, as these may be signs of infection.

title: Pricing
markdown:
## Quality Isn't expensive, it's priceless.

At Hairlusion, we believe in complete transparency and clarity when it comes to the investment you’re making in yourself. Scalp Micropigmentation is not just a procedure; it’s a life-changing decision that enhances your confidence and transforms your appearance. Our pricing reflects our commitment to excellence, the bespoke nature of each treatment, and the expertise of our team. Every scalp is unique, and so is every SMP journey.

[Get started](https://www.hairlusion.com/get-in-touch/)

## SMP Treatments

- Instant and Visible Results
- Non-Surgical and Low Maintenance
- Cost-Effective
- Boosts Confidence

## Full Head

**From £1200 per session**

A full head treatment is tailored for individuals experiencing the most advanced stage of hair loss, where up to 75 to 100% of their natural hair may be lost. This condition could be due to genetics, Alopecia, post-cancer treatments, or natural hair loss.

## Half Crown

**From £750 per session**

The half crown treatment addresses various patterns of hair loss, with the most common being the “horseshoe” pattern. This occurs when there is little to no hair from the hairline to the back of the crown. SMP effectively addresses this condition.

## Receding Hairline

**From £600 per session**

This treatment targets mild hair loss, often concentrated at the frontal hairline. Two common patterns include equal recession on the outer sides edging into the crown or recession primarily in the middle front section.

## Scalp Scars

**From £400 per session**

Scalp scars, resulting from injury or surgery, can lead to permanent hair loss in the affected area. SMP presents an optimal solution to conceal these scars, integrating flawlessly with your natural hair colour and effectively camouflaging scars from FUT and FUE hair transplant procedures.

## Female Thinning Crown

**From £550 per session**

Female Thinning Crown represents a progression of thinning with a larger area of sparse natural hair. As hair loss increases, more of the scalp becomes exposed. SMP is highly recommended to enhance density across the sparse scalp, giving the illusion of thicker, fuller hair.

## Female Thinning Parting

**From £450 per session**

Female Thinning Parting is a common condition, often genetically linked, where thinning occurs along the middle parting, extending outwards. SMP effectively adds density to the sparse scalp, creating the appearance of fuller, thicker hair.

## Hair Extension Damage

**From £350 per session**

Hair extensions and wigs are popular solutions for thinning hair or hair loss. However, prolonged use can lead to permanent scalp damage due to the adhesive used. This damage often results in bald areas on the scalp. SMP offers a solution by blending and camouflaging the damaged areas to match your natural hair colour.

title: FAQs
markdown:
## Your Questions Answered.

What is Scalp Micropigmentation (SMP)?

SMP is a non-surgical cosmetic procedure that involves the application of tiny, simulated hair follicles on the scalp to create the illusion of a closely shaved or fuller head of hair.

How does SMP work?

SMP is performed by using specialised micro-needles to deposit pigment into the upper layer of the scalp, replicating the appearance of hair follicles. This technique creates a realistic, natural-looking hairline and adds density to areas of hair loss.

Why choose Hairlusion?

With Hairlusion, you’re choosing more than just a hair restoration service – you’re choosing a partner who understands firsthand the journey you’re on. As a former client myself, I’ve walked in your shoes and have used my personal experience to develop a bespoke technique tailored to your individual needs. My commitment to providing personalised care, combined with my innovative approach, ensures that you receive the highest standard of service and achieve natural, long-lasting results. Trust Hairlusion to restore your confidence and transform your life.

Is SMP suitable for both men and women?

Yes, SMP can be performed on both men and women who are experiencing hair loss, thinning hair, or have areas of baldness they wish to camouflage.

Will SMP work for all stages of hair loss?

SMP is effective for various types and stages of hair loss, including receding hairlines, crown balding, and complete hair loss. It can also help conceal scars resulting from hair transplant surgeries or accidents.

How long does an SMP procedure typically take?

The duration of an SMP procedure depends on the extent of the treatment area. SMP is a layering process, and the density is built up gradually in each session. On average, a session can take two to five hours. Most clients undergo between 3-5 sessions to achieve the desired results, with each session contributing to the overall density.

Is SMP a permanent solution?

SMP is considered a semi-permanent solution. The carbon ink used in SMP are designed to fade gradually over time, typically lasting for several years. Periodic touch-up sessions may be necessary to maintain the desired appearance.

Does SMP require any maintenance or touch-ups?

Yes, SMP may require occasional touch-up sessions to maintain the color vibrancy and ensure the desired results are maintained. The frequency of touch-ups varies from person to person.

Are there any side effects or risks associated with SMP?

The risks associated with SMP are minimal. Some individuals may experience temporary redness, mild swelling, or minor discomfort following the procedure. These effects typically subside within a few days.

Can SMP be done on any skin type or colour?

Yes, SMP can be performed on various skin types and colours. By adjusting the ink dilution, we match the client’s natural hair colour and skin tone, ensuring a seamless and realistic result.

Will SMP look natural?

When performed by a skilled and experienced SMP technician, the results of SMP are designed to look highly natural. The technique involves careful consideration of hairline design, colour blending, to create a realistic appearance.

What is the recovery process like after SMP?

The recovery process after SMP is relatively quick and straightforward. There may be some minor redness and scabbing in the treated area, which typically subsides within a week or two. It is important to follow post-treatment care instructions provided.

Can I still shave my head if I have SMP?

Yes, one of the advantages of SMP is that it allows individuals to maintain a shaved or closely cropped hairstyle. The pigmented areas are designed to blend seamlessly with the existing hair or provide the appearance of a full head of hair even when shaved.

Can SMP be used to cover scars and alopecia?

Yes, SMP can be an effective solution for camouflaging scars resulting from hair transplant procedures, accidents, or medical conditions like alopecia. The pigmentation can help blend the scarred areas with the surrounding hair, providing a more uniform and natural look.

How much does SMP cost?

The cost of SMP can vary depending on factors such as the extent of the treatment area, the complexity of the hair loss pattern, and the geographical location. It’s is advised to have a complimentary consultation to get accurate pricing information tailored to your specific case.

Can I go swimming or expose my scalp to the sun after SMP?

It is recommended to avoid exposing the treated scalp to excessive sunlight, chlorine, or saltwater during the initial healing period. Once the scalp has fully healed, it is safe to resume normal activities, including swimming and sun exposure, while taking appropriate protection precautions.

Are there any limitations or restrictions after getting SMP?

Following SMP, it is advisable to avoid strenuous activities, excessive sweating, and rubbing or scratching the treated area. It is also important to follow the SMP aftercare including avoiding certain hair products or treatments that may affect the pigmentation.

Can SMP be combined with other hair restoration treatments?

SMP can be used as a standalone treatment or combined with other hair restoration techniques, such as hair transplants or topical hair growth treatments. Combining treatments can provide more comprehensive and customised results.

What results can I expect from SMP?

SMP is designed to provide realistic and natural-looking results. It can create the appearance of a fuller head of hair, a defined hairline, or camouflage areas of baldness or scars. The outcome will depend on individual factors, such as hair loss severity and skin type. A complimentary consultation can give you a better understanding of the expected results for your specific case.

title: Cookie policy
markdown:
## Cookies and your choices

This website stores your cookie preference in your browser for six months and uses session storage to avoid repeating the introductory animation. These preferences are stored on your device.

## Optional video content

Vimeo videos are loaded only when you allow optional content and choose to play a video. Vimeo then receives information such as your IP address and may use its own cookies or storage. We request its do-not-track playback mode. External links to YouTube or Vimeo open their websites, where their own privacy settings apply.

## Analytics and advertising

This version of the website does not load analytics or advertising scripts. Accepting optional content does not activate any advertising service.

## Change your preference

Use the Cookie settings button at the bottom of the screen to change your choice. Essential only keeps embedded videos disabled. You can still read the website, see locally hosted client photographs and use the contact options.

## Contact

For questions about your privacy, email [info@hairlusion.com](mailto:info@hairlusion.com). See our [privacy policy](/privacy-policy/) for more information.
